content: अंसः [अंस् कर्मभावादौ अच्] .²1 A part, portion; see अंशः. .²2 The shoulder, shoulder-blade; यदयं रथसंक्षोभादंसेनांसो रथोपमश्रोण्याः <ls>V. 1. 13</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a prince. .({@-सौ@}) The two angles of an altar [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Goth.</lang> {%amsa%}; <lang>L.</lang> {%ansa%}, {%humerus%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%omor%}.]
